svg.title: Herringbone parquet — Fiskbeinamynstur í parketi
svg.desc: Six long parquet planks form three interlocking perpendicular pairs, with square ends meeting neighbouring long edges.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-herringbone-parquet","label_en":"Herringbone parquet","label_is":"Fiskbeinamynstur í parketi","section":"12","category_en":"Flooring, tiling and interior finishes","category_is":"Gólfefni, flísalögn og innanhússfrágangur","batch":6,"tags":["construction","flooring","parquet"],"description":"Six long parquet planks form three interlocking perpendicular pairs, with square ends meeting neighbouring long edges.","design_note":"The planks meet at right angles as herringbone; this is not a mitred-chevron pattern.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
